# Vazirmatn

Bundled Persian/Arabic UI typeface for Veil Reader.

- Upstream: rastikerdar/vazirmatn
- Upstream tag: v33.003
- Variant: UI
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (see OFL.txt)
- Runtime delivery: bundled locally; Veil does not download fonts

## Bundled weights and upstream Git blob SHAs

- Regular — `0b68e819d5353d7f2b1ea457ccdeffbec8fa7f3d`
- Medium — `caa2056cf6b7506caba2c93ca23f6b18dad27c72`
- SemiBold — `9eff472fef7e44718bb35dff7db9ceaf5c5b7671`
- Bold — `b76f47e958fdef5cf109107a77da325e87399b0f`

The blobs committed to Veil retain these content-addressed SHAs, providing a direct integrity
check against the selected upstream tag. The font files are unmodified.
